summary: This Makefile defines three convenience targets that open different pages of a Git repository in your default web browser. Each target uses the sensible-browser command to launch a URL, with the base repository URL stored in the GIT_URL_REPO variable and different paths appended for the repo, pipelines, and wiki pages.

explanations.2: The @ symbol suppresses the command from being printed to the terminal before it runs, so you only see the result. ${GIT_URL_REPO} substitutes the variable value into the URL.
explanations.5: This appends /pipelines to the base repository URL to open the CI/CD pipelines page specifically.
explanations.8: This appends /-/wikis/home to open the repository's wiki home page; the /-/ is GitLab's internal path separator.
